evidence_class_definitions.documentation: Narrative, specification, source, or metadata record; not review completion.
evidence_class_definitions.execution_evidence: A test, checker, fixture, or execution receipt bounded to its declared inputs.
evidence_class_definitions.formal_proof: A Lean or SMT artifact bounded to its encoded statement and trusted toolchain.
evidence_class_definitions.human_review: A named human review disposition; absent unless a record explicitly supplies it.
evidence_class_definitions.inventory: A file/object inventory; it does not imply that lines or mathematics were reviewed.
evidence_class_definitions.line_review: A blob-bound line/code review disposition; absent unless explicitly recorded.
evidence_class_definitions.model_review: Advisory output from a model; not human, institutional, or independent review.
evidence_class_definitions.tag_release_fact: A Git tag or release-state fact; not a scientific or code-review disposition.

nonimplications: The view is not an authority independent of audit/evidence/assurance-registry.json.
No transitive paper-to-application correctness chain is established.
Inventory is not line review; model review is not human or independent review.
Formal artifacts do not by themselves establish source correspondence, implementation refinement, or application validity.
Execution evidence remains bounded to its declared inputs, toolchains, and assumptions.
Git tag and release facts do not establish review, authenticity, or scientific validity.

release_facts.status_semantics: historical tag published for source review; no completed line or human review is inferred
